BEJSON 104 Foundational Libraries (Libraries_104)

Foundational Era BEJSON 104 / 104a / 104db polyglot library suite across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Bash with O(1) Field Map Caching and zero-dependency flat-file persistence.

Key Capabilities

  • Schema-First Tabular Storage: Eliminates repeated JSON key bloat with 95% token compression.
  • Multi-File Databases (MFDB v1.31): Relational flat-file manifests and 104db document payloads.
  • Polyglot Parity: Identical core contracts across Python, JS/TS, and Bash.
